summary: Sort intervals by start time, then sweep once to merge overlaps or insert a new interval in place.
recognize_when: input is a list of [start, end] ranges
asking to merge, insert, or find overlapping intervals
need to find free/busy time gaps
'overlap' or 'conflict' appears in the problem statement

complexity.notes: dominated by the sort; the merge sweep itself is O(n)

gotchas: forgetting to sort first (or sorting by end instead of start)
using < instead of <= when checking overlap, mishandling touching intervals like [1,2] and [2,3]
mutating the input list's inner lists when tuples were expected, or not copying before mutating
